subject: POV plan, acceptance gates, hotfix routing and escalation contacts
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@brightforge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POV scope & initial acceptance gates (post-call recap)

Thanks again for taking the time this morning, Marta — good conversation. Per our call, I wanted to capture the agreed POV scope, ownership, and immediate next steps so we have a single source of truth. Attached: BF-POV-scope.xlsx (scope + testcases). Also attaching the Redwood POV privacy checklist for the security folks.

Quick recap (high level):
- Goal: Validate latency and cost for BrightForge inference workload (news summarization microservice) at 2k requests/day, 99th pct latency < 350ms, and embed quality parity against baseline.
- Duration: 3 week timebox (start: 2026-09-07) with option to extend for remediation sprint.
- Key acceptance gates (preliminary):
  1) Functional: sample dataset processing + 95% successful response rate under baseline load.
  2) Performance: p50/p95/p99 latency and cost per 1k tokens within thresholds in the attached sheet.
  3) Security: privacy checklist signed off and basic network isolation verified.

Owners:
- Redwood: Logan (POC lead), Marissa (onboarding & infra), Ben (runtime tuning).
- BrightForge: Marta (POV sponsor), procurement looped for SOW.

Blockers we flagged: secure S3 access to sample corpus, model licensing confirmation for the chosen open checkpoint, and procurement contract sign. Proposed mitigations in sheet + hotfix-routing doc.

Immediate next steps (this week):
- Logan: send final POV scope (attached) and estimated infra quote to procurement by Fri 08/28.
- Marta: confirm sample dataset access and share contact for environment creds.
- Marissa: prepare a pre-flight checklist (network, VPC peering, encryption at rest).

If this matches your understanding, please reply +1 and I'll start the procurement thread.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0183

Attachments: BF-POV-scope.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-pov-privacy-checklist.pdf (PDF)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@brightforge.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POV scope & initial acceptance gates (pre-flight checklist + mitigations)

Adding operational details and a short risk matrix so everyone has visibility before infra creds arrive.

Operational plan (Marissa):
- Week 0 (prep, 2026-09-07 to 2026-09-10): network checks, IAM + bucket access, model license confirmation.
- Week 1 (baseline run, 2026-09-11 to 2026-09-17): ingest sample set, baseline runs, metric capture.
- Week 2 (tuning + stress, 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-24): runtime tuning (Ben), prefix/KV cache tests, batching.
- Week 3 (acceptance & signoff, 2026-09-25 to 2026-09-29): final acceptance tests and closing retro.

Acceptance gates (finalized):
- Gate A: Dataset ingest verified + 95% success under baseline load (owner: Marissa).
- Gate B: p95 latency < 300ms, p99 < 420ms (owner: Ben).
- Gate C: Embedding recall within 3% of BrightForge baseline (owner: Logan).
- Gate D: Privacy checklist signed; data retention policy confirmed (owner: Kimberly).

Risk matrix (top 3):
1) Blocker: Missing model license (impact: cannot run trial). Mitigation: temporary eval license request to model provider; alternative quantized checkpoint on standby. Escalation path: Kimberly -> Security leadership -> Legal.
2) Blocker: No S3 access (impact: delays start). Mitigation: provide scp of 5k sample files as fallback; preloaded snapshot to Redwood test bucket. Escalation: Marissa -> Logan -> Marta.
3) High-severity bug in runtime that causes KV cache corruption under load (impact: data integrity + restart). Mitigation: run canary with KV cache disabled; if hit, apply hotfix from hotfix-runbook.md. Escalation: Ben -> Runtime Eng (oncall) -> Redwood infra SLA exec.

Hotfix routing and SLAs:
- For P0 (data integrity / production parity fail): immediate page to runtime oncall, cc Kimberly and Logan.
- For P1 (severe perf regression): 4-hour remediation window from triage.
- For P2: standard bug queue.

Marissa will upload the pre-flight checklist and the hotfix-runbook to the Jira ticket (POV-238) by EOD. Ben, please confirm resource slots on 09/18-09/24 for tuning. Kimberly, can you confirm you can support license/legal escalation if needed?

- Marissa
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced: hotfix-runbook.md (markdown), preflight-checklist.pdf

Thanks all — quick status and commitments before procurement review next week.

Status:
- Infra quote and draft SOW: attached to procurement (see Drive link). Estimated cost for 3-week POV: $6,200 (credits/discounts applied).
- Dataset creds: Marta's infra lead confirmed S3 access; credentials pending, expected Mon 08/30.
- Model license: submitted eval license request (tracking ID: ML-EVAL-824); contingency checkpoint queued.

Committed owners & contacts (for escalation):
- POV lead / commercial: Logan Wright (logan.wright@redwoodinference.com)
- Onboarding / infra: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com)
- Runtime / hotfix lead: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwoodinference.com)
- Security / license escalation: Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com)

Acceptance gates (short): Gate A (ingest), Gate B (perf), Gate C (embed parity), Gate D (privacy). We will capture metric pass/fail in Jira POV-238 and include screenshots + raw CSVs.

Escalation path (if blocker persists beyond mitigation window):
1) Raise ticket in POV-238 with severity tag and notify Logan + Marissa.
2) If unresolved in 8 business hours for P0 or 24 hours for P1, Kimberly will initiate exec-level escalation (Legal/Security/Customer Success).

Next steps for procurement: Logan will share the SOW and cost breakdown with procurement and Marta by Monday 08/30. Marta — please confirm whether PO approval meeting stays on Wed 09/01 or needs to be moved.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth run.

Logan Wright
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
